The general nvar transfer from 1-var agreements is FALSE without Prior-UZ/SZ. Counterexample: (0,2) and (0,1) in (Z,<) have same 1-var types at each component and same order, but different 2-var NFs because the gap between them has different cardinality. Prior-UZ/SZ constrains gap structure to make the lemma true.

The fundamental quantifier-step difficulty: from depth-(d+1) 1-var agreement at component i, exist_transfer_from_full_agree gives depth-d 2-var existential transfer. This finds a witness with matching type relative to ONE component, but potentially DIFFERENT witnesses for different components. Prior-UZ first-occurrence resolves this by placing the witness in the correct gap (between consecutive sorted env' components), giving correct orders relative to ALL components simultaneously.
